# Token Action HUD Core 2.1.2
For a guide on using Token Action HUD, go to: [How to Use Token Action HUD](https://github.com/Larkinabout/fvtt-token-action-hud-core/wiki/How-to-Use-Token-Action-HUD)

> [!WARNING]  
> Do not update Token Action HUD Core until your Token Action HUD system modules support version 2.1.X.

> [!IMPORTANT]  
> For Token Action HUD system developers, `requiredCoreModuleVersion` must be set to `"2.1"`. From 2.1, if you wish to always support minor versions, you can set it to `"2"` instead.

## For Developers
See [Core Changes for System Module Developers](https://github.com/Larkinabout/fvtt-token-action-hud-core/wiki/Core-Changes-for-System-Module-Developers#token-action-hud-core-210)

## Improvements
- Added option for system modules to exclude generic actions from the HUD.
- Added handling to automatically refresh group names from the system.
- Improved context menu handling to keep the hovered group open.
- Improved button styling.

## Bug Fixes
- [#341] Fixed error when resetting layout and actor is not selected nor assigned.
- [#372] Fixed custom layout not loading when user has file browse permission and the GM is present.
- [#376] Fixed tooltip delay setting.
- [#382] Fixed error when tooltips are enabled and the cached HUD style is missing.
- Fixed listeners on scene navigation to make sure the HUD appears under their context menus.
- Fixed the rendering of icons added to the `icons` array.
- Fixed error logging.
- Fixed tooltip display of button info elements.
- Fixed layout data saving twice when user has file upload permission.
- Fixed the HUD from reloading every time a compendium update is triggered.

# Token Action HUD Core 2.0.4
For a guide on using Token Action HUD, go to: [How to Use Token Action HUD](https://github.com/Larkinabout/fvtt-token-action-hud-core/wiki/How-to-Use-Token-Action-HUD)

> [!WARNING]  
> Do not update Token Action HUD Core until your Token Action HUD system modules support version 2.0+.

> [!IMPORTANT]  
> This release is compatible with Foundry VTT 12 only.

## New Features
### Docked HUD
There are three new styles available in the 'Style' module setting: Docked Left, Docked Center-Right and Docked Right. These present the HUD as a fixed vertical list in various positions. Please note, the following module settings do not interact with these HUD styles: Direction, Grid, Hud Scale, Dragging.
![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/49b4900d-440b-4a7c-8e3b-ab887c5fb94f)

### Controls
Located in **Game Settings** > **Configure Controls** > **Token Action HUD Core**, there are two controls:
* **Enable/Disable HUD**: As the name suggests, this control enables or disables the HUD.
* **Collapse/Expand HUD**: This control collapses or expands the HUD.

## Improvements
### Application V2
Updated the HUD and all forms to Application V2.

## Developers
See [Core Changes for System Module Developers](https://github.com/Larkinabout/fvtt-token-action-hud-core/wiki/Core-Changes-for-System-Module-Developers#token-action-hud-core-200)

## Bug Fixes
- Fixed 'undefined (reading 'actorId') error (#277).
- Fixed error causing 'Failed to migrate files to persistent storage'.

# New Features
## 'Reset All Layouts' module setting
The 'Reset All Layouts' module setting available to GMs and located in the 'Layout' module settings window enables the GM to reset layouts for all users. This is useful when setting a global default layout, but be aware that it will reset all customisations made by individual users.

## 'Tooltip Delay' module setting
The 'Tooltip Delay' enables individual users to control how long the initial tooltip takes to display when hovering over an action.

# Improvements
- Added support for icons on groups.
- Added support for CSS classes on groups.
- Layout file paths are now retrieved and stored at startup to avoid browsing for files each time a token is selected (#194).

- Fix CSS for info texts on tab buttons (#186).
- Fixed `icon` property when creating actions (#189).
- Fixed the 'Sort Actions Alphabetically' module setting not applying until after a reload.
- Fixed error when updating compendiums (#198).

# New Features
## User Default Layout (#183)
Set your own default layout using the new 'User Default Layout' module setting in the Layout menu. This will override the default layout set by the GM (now named Global Default Layout) and the system default.
![image](https://github.com/Larkinabout/fvtt-token-action-hud-core/assets/105953297/0ff2be9e-975a-42a1-b1eb-3864a8a87838)
## Sort Actions Alphabetically
Sort all actions alphabetically by default using the new 'Sort Actions Alphabetically' module setting. This setting will only take effect when actions are reset using the 'Reset Actions within Groups' button or when a group is added to the HUD.

# Improvements
- If a user has permission to browse files or upload files, a GM is no longer required to be present to retrieve or save the user's HUD layout, respectively. For users without these permissions, a GM is still required to retrieve or save a user's HUD layout on their behalf.

# Token Action HUD Core 1.4.0
This minor release adds extra customisation options and moves the data for saved HUDs to the data folder instead of using actor and user flags.

**IMPORTANT:** This release is not compatible with Token Action HUD system modules that require minor version 1.3.2 or earlier. Do not update Token Action HUD Core until all your installed Token Action HUD system modules support this version.

For Token Action HUD system module developers, see [Core Changes for System Module Developers](https://github.com/Larkinabout/fvtt-token-action-hud-core/wiki/Core-Changes-for-System-Module-Developers)

## Saving HUD Data
Actor and user data is now saved to the data folder within a 'token-action-hud-core' folder instead of within the actor and user flags. As a result, the [socketlib](https://foundryvtt.com/packages/socketlib) module is now required to allow users to save their HUD layout. Token Action HUD Core will attempt to migrate saved HUDs to the data folder for a world when it is first loaded.

## New Features
### Customise Style
Customise the HUD using the new 'Custom' style and the 'Customise Style' form.

![token-action-hud-core-collapse-groups](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/105953297/235941661-6dc2ff7d-51a5-4bbd-88e2-589d980e4ec4.gif)
### Group Styles
Choose between 'tab' or 'list' style groups using the context dialog.
![token-action-hud-core-group-style](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/105953297/235946744-8419b327-7f76-4b31-bb48-05108757150d.gif)

# Token Action HUD Core 1.1.0
This minor release adds a number of small features alongside an important change to how Token Action HUD Core registers the Token Action HUD system module.

**IMPORTANT:** This release is not compatible with system modules that require minor version 1.0.X. Token Action HUD system modules must be updated at the same time as updating to Token Action HUD Core 1.1.0.

## New Features
### Copy HUD Layout to Other Users
Copy a HUD layout from one user to other users via the copy function: `game.tokenActionHud.copy(fromUserId, toUserIds)`. `fromUserId` is the user id of the HUD to copy and `toUserIds` is a list of user ids for users whose HUD will be replaced by the copied HUD. `toUserIds` can be a single user id in a string (e.g., `'WF5nQA6a3rreoob1'`) or an array of user ids (e.g., `['WF5nQA6a3rreoob1', 'csXE2yzEtSy8hZMY']`. User ids can be copied from the User Configuration window available by right-clicking on a user in list at the bottom-left corner of Foundry VTT.

**Example**
```
game.tokenActionHud.copy('Vp3KdGVJjhSBFeyE', ['WF5nQA6a3rreoob1', 'csXE2yzEtSy8hZMY'])
```
### Show/Hide Titles
Save space on the HUD by hiding category and subcategory titles.

1. Unlock the HUD.
2. Right-click a category button or a subcategory title to open the dialog.
3. Untick 'Show Title'.
4. Click 'Accept'.
5. Lock the HUD.

![token-action-hud-hide-title](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/105953297/215357550-34bbdf47-d759-43dc-b629-fa4e3ed63940.gif)

### Category Button Image
Add an image to the category buttons. Remove the category title at the same time to have hotbar-like visual buttons.

1. Unlock the HUD.
2. Right-click a category button to open the dialog.
3. Click 'Browse Files' to open the Image Browser.
4. Select an image.
5. Click 'Select File'.
7. Click 'Accept'.
8. Lock the HUD.

![token-action-hud-category-image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/105953297/215774400-71478efd-00cf-4827-81e6-01b5e73b38d0.gif)

## Bug Fixes
- Fixed a bug where derived subcategories would disappear from the HUD when clicking between tokens.

## Improvements
- The HUD should no longer hold focus when it is clicked, which stopped the normal ESC interactions of deselecting tokens and opening the ESC menu.
- Token Action HUD Core now waits for a hook to be called by the Token Action HUD system module. For TAH system module developers, the following code is required in your module:
```
Hooks.once('ready', async () => {
    const module = game.modules.get(MODULE.ID)
    module.api = {
        requiredCoreModuleVersion: REQUIRED_CORE_MODULE_VERSION,
        SystemManager
    }
    Hooks.call('tokenActionHudSystemReady', module)
})
```
- The HUD dialogs have been rewritten as a Form Application, mainly to afford the use of the FilePicker helper. The layout has also had a tidy up.

## Bug Fixes
- Fixed an error produced when a user without an assigned character deselects all tokens.
- Fixed an error caused by an empty user flag.

## Bug Fixes
- Removed an errant console.log() flooding the console with messages.

# Token Action HUD Core 1.0.0
This release is an overhaul of the code to improve performance and make it easier to build system modules. Until I write the documentation on developing a Token Action HUD system module, if you're interested in developing a one for your favourite system now, raise an issue on here or drop me a message on Discord (Russell#7071) and I'll help get you started.

**IMPORTANT:** The first time you launch a world with this release, the module will attempt to migrate the Token Action HUD data stored within user flags. If it fails, the HUD will reset to the default configuration.

## New Features
### Nesting Subcategories
Add a subcateory to another subcategory using the Action dialog.

### Derived Subcategories
System modules can take advantage of "derived" subcategories to automatically add more subcategories within a subcategory. For example, the Token Action HUD D&D 5e module has subcategories for each activation type (Actions, Bonus Actions, Reactions, etc.) that, when added, will also add nested subcategories to group actions by other types (Inventory, Features, Spells, etc.).

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/105953297/214752489-91b420db-c254-4121-af02-e2b8e5537fc5.png)

## Improvements
- Quite a few behind-the-scenes performance tweaks, including rolling up files.
- Additional debugging when enabling the 'Enable Debugging' module setting. Make sure to keep this setting disabled while playing.
- Various CSS tweaks to make the HUD stand out better on any background.

## New Features
- Added a function to reset actions in the HUD for all actors. To use this function, execute `game.tokenActionHud.resetActorFlags()` in the console (F12) or in a macro.

## Bug Fixes
- Fixed an item duplication bug when the Item Macro module was enabled. If you have actors with duplicated items, run the `resetActorFlags()` function.

# Token Action HUD Core

This is the first release of **Token Action HUD Core**, a [Foundry VTT](https://foundryvtt.com) module and rewrite of the original Token Action HUD.

## New Features
- Unlock the HUD to customise categories and subcategories per user and actions per actor.
- Show the HUD when no token is selected by assigning users with a default character.

## Why Have One, When You Can Have Two
This release splits Token Action HUD's original code into interdependent core and system modules. This is intended to allow core features to be developed without impacting all systems at once.

**Both Token Action HUD Core and a Token Action HUD system module matching your chosen system must be installed to use this version of Token Action HUD.**

Current system modules as of this release:

- [Token Action HUD D&D 5e](https://foundryvtt.com/packages/token-action-hud-dnd5e)

It's advisable to install the Token Action HUD system module first as Token Action HUD Core is set as a required module.

## There May Be Bugs

This release largely rewrites the original code and adds in the complexity of interdependent modules, therefore there may be bugs. The best way to help improve this module is to raise an issue [here](https://github.com/Larkinabout/fvtt-token-action-hud-core/issues).

## What about the Original?

Support for the original [Token Action HUD](https://foundryvtt.com/packages/token-action-hud) will continue with bug fixes and any third-party pull requests until all existing systems are rewritten to the core/system framework.
